title: Lifecycle event records carry metadata only; no body, no user id, no PII
asA: operator wiring the logger and error-handling companions to the object-storage facade
iWant: every lifecycle event record to carry a fixed metadata-only shape
soThat: downstream loggers cannot leak object body bytes, user ids, or PII drawn from the object body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a lifecycle-event spy attached to the sink, when put, get, delete, and presign verbs run against a PII fixture (key users/1234/passport.jpg, body carrying the PII fixture text), then every event record on the sink carries only fields from the whitelist {event, key, size, contentType, ttl, timestamp, endpointHost, bucketName}; no field name matches userId or ssn or dob or email; no field value contains the PII fixture body text; no field value contains any part of the object body bytes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade opened, a spy on the event sink, a PII fixture body PII-FIXTURE-DO-NOT-LOG
acceptanceCriteria.when: putObject(users/1234/passport.jpg, image/jpeg, <body containing PII-FIXTURE-DO-NOT-LOG>), then getObject, then presignGetUrl, then deleteObject
acceptanceCriteria.then: every event record on the sink has keys drawn from the whitelist above; no event value contains the string PII-FIXTURE-DO-NOT-LOG; no event value contains a userId, ssn, dob, or email field; the key users/1234/passport.jpg appears on records as the key field only (not decomposed into userId)
